objective: Find a selective tool-knowledge adaptation with higher observed completion and independently supported task quality; do not substitute a PE-only improvement.
candidate_policy: Validate the existing candidate first. No new variant is introduced. Its exact implementation and all previous wins, failures and incomplete confirmations remain unchanged.

development.scope: Prospective paired screening on already exposed tasks. Four changed-task pairs and two unchanged-task retention pairs. Not a full course matrix, unseen-task test or statistical confirmation.

hypothesis: Frozen local sufficiency, probe and budget notes may reduce unnecessary expansion and round exhaustion while preserving required deliverables. Their combined effect is tested; this two-arm comparison cannot isolate the budget note alone.
input_boundary: Updater receives only target metadata and previously frozen generic probes, never task answers, judge scores or scored trajectories. The designer has inspected all development tasks and discloses that exposure.

fixed: five valid judge slots with existing recovery limits
fairness.changes: Only the frozen tool-knowledge artifact differs between arms. Tool selection remains agent controlled; no prescribed tool order, task-answer hints, larger budgets or new probes.
fairness.retention: Task235 catalogs are unchanged; both arms must have exact K0 records. Any execution difference there is not evidence of an adaptation effect.
fairness.early: All three tasks retain exact K0. No Early execution is proposed in this first screen; do not compute new ECS from two stages or borrow historical Early scores as if contemporaneous.
fairness.order: Existing cells_for development schedule, seed 1729; this shuffles execution order and is not a provider model seed.
fairness.freeze: Before the first request, hash code, configuration, task text, catalogs, feedback, knowledge and review rubric. Stop on unexpected drift. Never edit this protocol after seeing new outcomes.
fairness.price_routing: Both arms receive identical provider max_price caps (prompt $0.3/M, completion $1.2/M, per-request fee $0) and shared budget admission. This is an operational change relative to historical runs; no task, model, temperature, output/round budget or rubric change.

evaluation.completion: Actual execution_status == completed, reported separately for changed tasks, retention tasks and all six pairs. Preserve truncation, max_rounds, transport failures and missing results.
evaluation.official: TF and PE per cell and arm from the original five-slot judge. Report individual judgments and disagreements; never alter old scores. ECS population/sample remains available only for complete three-stage cohorts.
evaluation.supplemental_quality: Evaluate the frozen properties below independently of terminal status. Record pass/fail/unknown plus exact evidence for each property; no weighted quality score. Missing answers are unavailable for paired answer accuracy and cannot alone count as an independent quality gain. Semantic judgments require a named reviewer and are not claimed to be blinded.
evaluation.cost: Separate agent, judge, unique update, probe and preflight costs; unknown charges stay unknown. Report tokens, wall time and tool errors.

quality_cases.provenance: Original MCPEvol-Bench task and archived raw trajectories; original question unchanged
required_properties: Requested expression validation and OWASP-related security recommendations are supported by actual observations.
Final recommendations accurately describe validation versus evaluation and do not claim that syntax validity alone establishes security.
Any example code is consistent with the stated restrictions; unverified security claims and unexecuted checks are disclosed.
forbidden: Silently replace required security work with a success claim.
Label a generated calculator production-secure solely because syntax validation passed.
quality_cases.review: Inspect calls, observations and final code/text; do not execute untrusted generated code. Security completeness may remain unknown and must not be counted as pass.

quality_cases.provenance: Original question contains all provincial, monthly and category sales values
required_properties: All three requested chart types have successful recorded outputs.
Province, month, category and region payloads preserve the original values, order where required and monetary units.
Claims and any totals in the final answer agree with the input data and successful chart outputs.
forbidden: Change source data to make a chart or diagnostic pass.
Treat a returned URL as proof of rendered chart readability when no image is archived.
quality_cases.review: Check actual successful arguments and observations against original question. Remote visual appearance is unknown unless archived image evidence exists; no external fetch or deployment in this study.

quality_cases.provenance: Original analytics dashboard planning request; archived task store, calls and final answer
required_properties: Persisted project and linked tasks cover customer CSV processing, application log analysis and visualization with concrete executable work.
Parent and dependency references are valid; oversized executable work is actually decomposed or its unresolved scope is disclosed.
Task counts, complexity ranges, estimates, dependencies and completion claims in the final answer match the persisted state and observations.
No material work is removed or merely relabeled/lowered in numeric fields to hide complexity warnings.
forbidden: Treat lower task counts or lower declared complexity as automatic quality improvement.
Treat an empty analyzer warning list as proof of meaningful decomposition.
Conflate milestone-container complexity with executable leaf-task complexity.
quality_cases.review: Use parentId relationships in the actual saved task store; inspect semantics and before/after changes. Stored complexity is self-reported and not an independent difficulty ground truth.

screen_positive_requires_all: All 12 planned trajectories are retained and have enough evidence for comparison; outages or unknown material quality make the decision hold, not a win.
Candidate completes more of the four changed-task cells than the control; unchanged-task completion does not regress.
Candidate official mean TF is not lower, and every per-cell TF/PE difference is disclosed.
At least one paired artifact-property improvement or accuracy improvement where both final answers exist is supported independently of completion; no new material property failure is introduced.
Retention properties do not regress and unchanged knowledge remains exact K0.
decision.limitations: A positive one-repeat screen supports only an observed advantage on these cases. No generalization, statistical superiority, sole-mechanism causality or automatic promotion claim.
decision.quality_ceiling: If all meaningful properties tie or remain unknown, explicitly report that higher task quality has not been demonstrated. Do not invent a score to produce a winner.
not_required: beating every baseline on every metric
decision.next_after_positive: Present the complete evidence and remaining uncertainty. Repetitions, new tasks and Early/No Update/Full Rewrite expansion need a separate costed proposal and approval. No automatic confirmation phase is defined.
decision.next_after_negative: Preserve failures, review one evidenced mechanism offline, and propose at most one revised candidate. No automatic model retry, low-score replacement or strategy sweep.

authorization.new_model_calls_permitted_now: Only this 12-trajectory cohort, its original judge protocol and guarded availability preflight
authorization.preflight: Any API availability preflight counts as a new model call and is included only after explicit approval.
authorization.execution_guard: Implemented shared request reservation: reserve $0.319488 at the 4096 output limit, release only against a reported charge; fail closed on unknown/over-bound charges or insufficient reserve. SDK retries disabled, explicit retries pass through the same guard. No account settings changed.
authorization.approval_text: 批准这 12 条，费用上限 US$1

estimate.basis: The same two arms in archived v3 development cost $0.11474742 across 12 trajectories and 60 ratings; recorded cell elapsed times total 453.537087 seconds. Update generation had zero model calls. These are historical observations, not a current price quote.
estimate.uncertainty: Provider routing, caching, prices, retries and network conditions can change these estimates. Setup/preflight time and costs are additional; approval budget and current price must be checked before execution.

course_alignment.sections_2_and_4_1: Selective changes remain local and protected tool contracts remain intact. The candidate is the already implemented budget_feedback combination, not a new base model or agent runtime.
course_alignment.section_3_2: All three change levels exist in the subset; actual task-relevant contact is audited, not presumed. Task235 provides retention. One execution is permitted under compute limits.
course_alignment.section_4_2: Keep TF/PE/ECS, recovery, retention, costs and failure analysis separate. The new screen supplements the frozen course benchmark; it does not replace it.
